title: Unit 11 Consolidation: Mixed Conditionals & Restrictive Conditions
goal: Review mixed conditionals, strict conditions, exceptions and polite si phrases, and read a text about Mario Benedetti and his novel La tregua.

items: Review the two mixed conditionals: a past condition with a result now, and a lasting trait with a past result.
Review the connectors that set conditions and name exceptions.
Read a text about the writer Mario Benedetti and his novel La tregua.
I can say how a different past would change the present, and how a lasting trait would have changed the past.
I can set conditions and name exceptions with the connectors of this unit.
I can soften a statement with a polite si phrase.
I can read a short text about Mario Benedetti and his novel La tregua.
